full_judgment: 4. The suit was contested by the respondent Nos. 1 and 2. Their case, in short, is that Pear Baksha, the predecessor of the respondent Nos. 1 and 3 took settlement of 0.11 acres of land out of the suit CS Khatian from the ex-landlord, and after the death of Pear Baksha his two sons, the respondent Nos.1 and 3 and two daughters, the respondent Nos. 5 and 6 and wife the respondent No.4 inherited the said lands. The respondent Nos. 1 and 3 have been possessing the lands over statutory period by making constructions and thereupon the respondent No.1 transferred 434 ajutangsha land in favour of the respondent No.2 and his wife Kohinur. Though the SA Khatian was prepared in the names pear Baksha and others they have had no possession therein. The appellants deed are forged and collusive.
